prompt: A desktop web page rendered edge to edge at 1440x900, no browser window, no address bar, no device frame. Dark matte ink background, near-black cool grey #0d0e10. No gradients, no glow, no neon, no glassmorphism, no drop shadows, no rounded cards. Structure: thin 48px top bar with wordmark PCPORT left in expanded grotesque capitals 18px wide-letterspaced white, PT/EN links right, 1px hairline rule beneath. A LEAD BAND occupying the top third, 280px tall, the page's single focal move, announcing the newest release: left, the title 'God of War III Remastered' in expanded grotesque about 64px white; beneath it one grey line 'Port nativo - PlayStation 4 - lancado ha 7 dias'. Right half of the band: four large measured figures in tight monospace each with a tiny uppercase grey label above - 144 FPS / MEDIA 1080P, v1.0 / VERSAO, 12 OUT / LANCAMENTO, 4.2 GB / TAMANHO. A single flat emerald chip reads NATIVO. No image, no cover art, no illustration, type and figures only. A 1px hairline rule closes the band. Below, the filter row: a real search input with thin border, placeholder 'Buscar jogo', and four real select dropdowns Console, Mecanismo, Plataforma, Ordenar. The lower half is the dense data table, headers in small uppercase letterspaced grey monospace JOGO / CONSOLE / MECANISMO / VERSAO / DATA / STATUS, 10 visible rows at 36px separated only by 1px hairline rules, no cards or containers. Titles in white grotesque 16px; all numbers in tight tabular monospace 14px aligned down the columns. The ONLY colour anywhere is the status chips: flat, 2px radius, no glow, emerald for Nativo, amber for Recompilado, violet for Traducao, slate for Em progresso. Everything else neutral grey and white. Dense, institutional, precise. The scale jump between the lead band's huge type and the table's small type is the whole composition.
